data.one_liner: Detects incoming calls and phone call status on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to quickly know if your Android or iOS device is receiving a call and track the current status of the call via a stream. On Android, it can also provide the caller's phone number if the optional permission is granted.
use_when: You need to detect incoming phone calls in your app
You need to monitor the status changes of cellular phone calls on Android or iOS
avoid_when: You need to answer, reject, end, or record phone calls
You need to detect VoIP calls from apps like WhatsApp or Telegram
strengths: Easy-to-use stream-based API for call state tracking
Supports both Android and iOS platforms
weaknesses: Does not work on the iOS simulator
Caller phone number is only available on Android, not iOS
Does not support third-party VoIP calls from apps like WhatsApp or Telegram
data.setup_notes: Add READ_PHONE_STATE permission to AndroidManifest.xml. READ_CALL_LOG is optional and only needed for caller phone numbers on Android.
